Bihar Job Vacancy 2026:bihar ke uchch shiksha kshetr men banpar bahali ki taiyari!| Breaking| Bihar News
Uchch shiksha vibhag men jald shuru hogi banpar bahali...
Kul 13 hajar 208 padon par bahali ka jald jari hoga vigyapan...
Vishvidyalyon aur nae kolejon men hogi bahali...
Sahayak pradhyapkon ke 10 hajar 479 pad, prachary ke 211 pad aur karmachariyon ke 2 hajar 518 padon par hogi bahali...
Uchch shiksha vibhag ke prastav ko vitt vibhag ne di hari jhandi...
Isi mahine niyukti ke prastav par kaibinet ki lag sakti hai muhar...
